plan.notes: MTSU 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog, Finance Major (B.B.A.), Jennings A. Jones College of Business. The catalog publishes degree requirements and a year-level academic map (Freshman/Sophomore/Junior/Senior, 30 hours each) but no official semester-by-semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block per coordinator convention. All 120 hours accounted for exactly as published. Major: 27 hours of finance courses (FIN 3110, FIN 3810, FIN 3950, FIN 4110, 12 hours upper-division FIN electives, 3 hours FIN elective); FIN 4780 Behavioral Economics and Finance is transcribed as the catalog's senior-year FIN elective. Auxiliary: MATH 1630/1810/1910 plus FIN 4015. Includes required Business Administration minor coursework within the business core. Minimum 2.00 GPA in major; 50% of major hours in residence.
